messages:
oliver: Final sync before GA launch tomorrow. Need to lock driver/CUDA/ROCm matrix and confirm rollback + hotpatch windows.
maria: Quick list of pinned versions and canary plan?
oliver: Current proposal:
```matrix
Driver: 535.86 (pin)
CUDA: 12.2
ROCm: 5.5 -> 5.6 for AMD partners (canary)
Quant kernels: q4m-compatible
```
jia: FYI CI flagged a perf regression w/ driver 536.25 + CUDA12.2 on p4 -> +30% tail latency in perf job #4821. Repro steps in the job log.
kevin: Is 536.25 in-market anywhere? If so we need a rollback path and marketplace pin doc.
sam: Marketplaces often auto-upgrade GPUs on their infra image. marketplace-biz: we can push a partner advisory and request pinning on launch images.
marketplace-biz: I'll prepare the partner advisory for 09:00 PT. Need the exact package sha and rollback runbook.
oliver: Rollback runbook (short):
1) Set env REDWOOD_DRIVER_PIN=535.86 in marketplace agent
2) Deploy image with patched runtime: rwd-infer:v1.3.2-hotfix
3) Trigger canary (10% traffic) & run smoke tests: /scripts/smoke_driver_check.sh
4) If green, promote to 100% else undo and open incident.

Command snippets:
```bash
kubectl set env deploy/inference-runtime REDWOOD_DRIVER_PIN=535.86 -n marketplace-prod
kubectl patch deployment inference-runtime -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"deployer":"redwood-hotpatch"}}}}}' -n marketplace-prod
```
jia: smoke test outputs we watch: mem usage, kv-cache hitrate, 99p latency at 2048 tokens. Jenkins job is jenkins.redwood/driver-smoke.
kevin: Can we pin at marketplace image level rather than runtime? Some partners prefer host-level driver pins.
oliver: Yes — we have two options documented. Runtime pin is fastest for us; host-level pin requires partner coordination and their image pipeline.
hw-partner-bot: AMD partner agreed to ROCm 5.5/5.6 gating; they want a canary window of 48 hours for telemetry.
marketplace-biz: Noted. We'll schedule partner advisory and include canary windows. Also include kernel ABI note for host pins.
maria: Who owns public communication if we need to delay launch?
oliver: marketplace-biz owns partner comms. Eng owns the rollback/hotpatch and the customer-facing status message.
oncall-bot: Reminder: assign oncall to driver-regression escalation (pager duty: @oncall-engineering)
sam: Final checklist for launch: artifacts uploaded (sha), partner advisory drafted, canary infra enabled, rollback runbook validated, postmortem template ready.
oliver: I'll run through a dry-run at 06:00 PT tomorrow and tag everyone. If any of you can't make it ping me before EOD.
maria: Ack. I'll validate the smoke test thresholds and add them to the advisory.
jia: I'll triage the perf reg tomorrow morning and prepare a minimal repro.
kevin: I'll double-check host pin options with our infra partners and report back.
marketplace-biz: Sending initial advisory draft in #partnerships tomorrow at 08:30 PT for signoff.
oliver: Thanks all. Keeping this thread for launch-day telemetry notes. :rocket:
